::: {.intro}
I work across data and analytics, building the systems, measurement frameworks, and tools that help make complex data easier to understand and use.

My focus spans the data lifecycle-from capturing and organizing raw telemetry to developing statistical models, exploring trends, and communicating results. I value simple, well-built solutions to complex problems and enjoy finding practical ways to make data more useful.
